title: Web designer
_note: Technical round built from the Web designer tasks in content/reference/occupations.json, which the team wrote from the eMASCO title (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2543-01) and has not yet checked against the eMASCO task list. Behavioural round: behavioural.json. Rubric format: content/interview/sets.ts.

questions.text: How would you plan the layout and user flow for a new website with the people who will use it?
questions.why: designers who skip users end up redesigning later.
questions.source: 2543-01 task 1 (content/reference/occupations.json): Plan page layouts and user flows with the people who will use a site. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: map the main tasks or user flow

questions.text: Tell us about a prototype you tested with users. What did you learn and what did you change?
questions.why: testing with real users finds problems early and cheaply.
questions.source: 2543-01 task 2 (content/reference/occupations.json): Design screens, wireframes and prototypes, then test them with users. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: give users real tasks to do
change the design because of it

questions.text: How do you turn a design into a page, or hand it over so a developer can build it?
questions.why: a design only matters once it is built correctly.
questions.source: 2543-01 task 3 (content/reference/occupations.json): Turn designs into pages with HTML and CSS, or hand them over to developers. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: share specs or a design system
